name: smg-monorepo
description: SMG — an original compact image format, codec library, CLI, and browser-based image studio.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @smg/codec && npm run build -w @smg/cli && node scripts/prepare-downloads.mjs && npm run build -w @smg/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @smg/codec && npm run build -w @smg/cli && node scripts/prepare-downloads.mjs && npm run build -w @smg/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/codec --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
